inputs.constraints:
This is a Ref2VA single-shot reference-generation request with exactly two attached images.
- <Picture 1> (the first image) is the ENVIRONMENT / scene asset. <Picture 2> (the second image) is the CHARACTER shot still.
- In subject_definitions: define <Subject 1> = the environment shown in <Picture 1>, and <Subject 2> = the character shown in <Picture 2>. Do NOT define any <Subject N> for N >= 3 and do NOT cite <Picture N> for N >= 3 anywhere in the output.
- In retention_analysis: mark both <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> as fully_preserved.
- In detailed_description: place <Subject 2> (the character) inside <Subject 1> (the environment), and keep <Subject 1>'s environment consistent throughout the shot. Use exactly one shot, labelled [Shot 1]; do NOT add [Shot 2] or any later shot.
- Keep the six fields in the fixed order: subject_definitions, summary, retention_analysis, detailed_description, overall_soundscape, non_diegetic_music. Output ONLY these six fields, no Markdown fence, no preface, no explanation, no suffix.
- Faithfully carry over the shot type, camera movement, emotion/action, and any dialogue from the input text; keep character names exactly as given; do not invent new characters or events.
